description: An AI-powered customer service platform providing ticketing, help desk, and customer engagement solutions.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, API tokens (bearer token), and basic authentication using email/password or username/token.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free 14-day trial account self-serve to obtain API credentials and test integrations.
api_notes: Extensive REST APIs covering ticketing, help center, AI agents, chat, voice, custom objects, and omnichannel functionality.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Zendesk; only community or third-party implementations may exist.
rationale: Publicly documented REST APIs are fully available, but API credential access is gated behind a trial or paid plan rather than a permanent free tier.

evidence.note: Provides documentation home, Sunshine platform, and REST API introduction.
Outlines the broad API surface including Ticketing, Help Center, AI Agents, and Chat APIs.
Mentions creating a developer account with a free 14-day trial account.
